# goslop text fixture — print-only handler at the top level of a function
# stays reportable (pyauto-desktop window_control.py:61 TP shape)
lang: python
file: top_print.py
---
def move_window(win, x, y):
    try:
        win.moveTo(int(x), int(y))
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to move window: {e}")
    return False
